cls: Preservative and mild topical anaesthetic; in cerumenolytic ear drops
pharm: Preservative and mild topical anaesthetic; in cerumenolytic ear drops
quick: 4 to 5 drops of the combination drops into the affected ear, two to three times daily
Do not use with a perforated eardrum
summary: Chlorbutol (chlorobutanol) is an antimicrobial preservative with mild local anaesthetic and sedative properties. In India it is best known in ear-wax drops with paradichlorobenzene, benzocaine and turpentine oil, and as a preservative in injections and eye drops.
indications: Softening of impacted ear wax (in combination ear drops)
Preservative in parenteral and ophthalmic products

dosage.d: 4 to 5 drops of the combination drops into the affected ear, two to three times daily
dosage.t: 3 to 4 days, then syringing if needed
dosage.n: Plug with cotton wool after instillation

admin: Warm the bottle in the hand before use
Tilt the head for a few minutes after instilling
moa: Antibacterial and antifungal preservative; mild local anaesthetic action.

absolute: Otitis externa with broken skin (for ear drops)

preg: Safety not established; use only if clearly needed
lact: Safety not established; weigh benefit against unknown risk
counsel: Use exactly as the pack directs
Stop and seek care for rash, swelling or breathing difficulty
missed: Take it when remembered unless the next dose is due; do not double up.
overdose: No specific antidote. Supportive and symptomatic care.
